newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Richardson expected to leave for Congo Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Richardson expected to leave for Congo Thursday.

text.p: U.S. Ambassador Bill Richardson expects to leave for Kinshasa next Thursday as head of an inter-agency team to put across Washington's views, U.S. sources said.

The Clinton administration is sending Richardson, the chief U.S. representative to the United Nations, to speak to Laurent Kabila, the new president of the Democratic Republic of Congo who was sworn in on Thursday.
Richardson has said he will discuss economic and political reforms as well as the plight of Rwandan Hutu refugees.
